title: The Cat and the Crow
plan_warnings: Four new animals (cat, leopard, dog, sheep) is the upper limit for one film; cat is already planned for AN-014 and should be drawn once for both. If time is short, sheep can be simplified to static wool shapes with a head bob.
The Arabic word for the predator is translated as leopard in the supplied English; the plan follows the English (spots, not stripes).
S5 is diagram heavy; if it reads as cluttered at phone size drop the TOO FAR label and keep the two X marks and the two bars.
The word times marked for long words (for example 79.20, 100.78, 107.20) include a little leading silence; check onsets on the waveform for the lunge at 79.2 and the charge at 133.12.
The crow (s 0.95) is large next to the cat (s 0.9) by real proportions; this is deliberate for phone legibility.
